message.reasoning:
Assess. C1: intro covers mission, rationale, one satellite, users — good, references. Accomplished, 8.

C2: launch, orbit with elements, maneuvers, ground station, comms frequency, duration, EOL — all addressed with STK screenshots and access report. Some errors: "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" (contradiction), "retrograde" SSO at 97.79° is slightly retrograde — fine. Drag sail section has garbled sentence. Also "without thrusters... uncontrolled descent... However, without thrust capability" contradictory. Adequate-to-accomplished; some errors and lack of hand calc detail. Give 7? Weight 60 — mark within 7-10. I'd say 7.

C3: conclusion summarizes but somewhat generic; adequate 5-6. Give 6.

C4: structure clear, figures labelled but some figure captions missing numbers ("STK 3D view"), bibliography is bare URLs, Wikipedia used (unacceptable source per task). Adequate 5.

Requirements: R1 yes, R2 yes, R3 yes, R4 yes, R5 yes, R6 yes, R7 yes, R8 yes, R9 yes (STK), R10 partial (screenshots yes; files not shown/included evidence unclear), R11 partial (Wikipedia cited, bare URLs).
